intent: 問題文の「小数第 3 位まで答えよ」
en: Round your answer to three decimal places.
ja: （電卓問題）答えは小数第 4 位を四捨五入して、小数第 3 位まで求めよ。

variants.en: Give your answer correct to three decimal places.
Your answer should be accurate to three places after the decimal point.
variants.note: three places after the decimal point は AP Calculus の CED（Unit 2 の概要）の言い方。CED は四捨五入か切り捨て（rounding or truncating）で小数第 3 位までにすると書く。

sources.title: College Board, AP Calculus AB and BC Course and Exam Description (Effective Fall 2020)
